settings.text: The world's first premium body-makeup brand, created by a dancer and a chemist for those who perform on stage and under the spotlight.

settings.title: Made in Ukraine. Chosen by champions.
settings.text:
We don't just sell cosmetics. We create professional solutions that deliver confidence, radiance and a flawless look in the most important moment — on the floor, on stage, at the competition.

Whether you dance in Blackpool, compete at a championship or own the stage — JOSS is your talisman for good luck.

settings.title: Scientifically developed
settings.text: A formula resistant to sweat, moisture and active movement — so your look lasts from first step to final bow.

settings.title: Fast, even application
settings.text: Tools and textures designed for quick, uniform coverage across the whole body.

settings.title: The "wow" effect
settings.text: Rich tan shades, shimmer and long-lasting fixation that read beautifully under stage lights.
